5.5% Assumable Mortgage Opportunity! Discover the versatility and convenience of this well-maintained ranch nestled on a spacious village lot with a fantastic setting backing directly to Butts Park and Oak Orchard Creek. Offering easy single-level living, the home features a bright, open layout with a spacious kitchen with granite countertops, a generous dining area with bay window, and an inviting family room with vaulted ceilings, a charming loft, and wood-burning stove. Two comfortable bedrooms and an updated full bath with heated floors complete the main living space.

Accessibility is thoughtfully incorporated throughout the home, with numerous handicap-accessible features and convenient first-floor living. Step outside onto the maintenance-free deck, accessible by stairs or elevator chair lift, and enjoy the large covered entertaining area, attached carport, and plenty of outdoor space.

The property is especially well suited for hobbyists, car enthusiasts, small business owners, or anyone needing additional workspace. The impressive 1,000± square foot heated garage features Thermopane windows and 50-amp electrical service, while a separate 12' x 24' outbuilding provides even more room for storage, projects, or equipment. A circular driveway offers abundant off-street parking, including space for recreational vehicles.

Enjoy the best of both convenience and recreation with direct access to the park, where you'll find ball fields, basketball courts, walking trails, and scenic green space. All of this is just minutes from Medina's historic downtown, local shops, restaurants, and amenities. With its unique combination of flexible living space, impressive outbuildings, accessibility, and an unbeatable location, this property offers a lifestyle that's truly hard to duplicate.
